title: The best tempo keepers
summary: Crawford names Cupie Austin, Sid Catlett, Jo Jones and Kaiser Marshall as the best tempo men.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who were some of the best tempo keepers to your mind? A lot of times, you listen to things and peices start in one temp and then --

Oh, that was so many, so many good tempo men. Cupie Austin, in McKenney's Cotton Pickers, Big Sid Catlett, Jo Jones. Fall in on some breaks, there, snare drum to a sock cymbal, tom-toms, they were good men. Kaiser Marshall was a good -- had to be good to play with Fletcher Henderson's band. Old timer, but he stuck to his style.
